caption:
One small thing to add to your shopping list from October to March.

From October to March the sun here is too low in the sky for your skin to make enough vitamin D, even on a bright day like this one. So the NHS suggests 10 micrograms a day for everyone over 4. It's one of the cheapest things on the shelf.

Save this for your next supermarket trip, and share it with someone who's never heard of it.
